description: This source file defines the ClusterMembershipSnapshot class, which encapsulates a snapshot of cluster membership data, including members, their statuses, and versioning, along with methods for comparison and state retrieval within the Orleans distributed runtime framework.

classes.name: ClusterMembershipSnapshot
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of the cluster's membership state, including members, their statuses, versioning, and provides methods for generating updates and string representation.

methods.name: ClusterMembershipSnapshot
methods.description: Constructor initializing the snapshot with members and version.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Provides a default, empty snapshot with minimum version.

methods.name: GetSiloStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a specified silo, determining if it is active, dead, or unknown.

methods.name: AsUpdate
methods.description: Returns a ClusterMembershipUpdate representing this snapshot.

methods.name: CreateUpdate
methods.description: Creates an update reflecting differences from a previous snapshot to this one.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Generates a string representation of the snapshot including version and members.
